titulo: Peruvian police locate bodies of security guards allegedly abducted by illegal goldminers

fuente.nota: Texto recortado por párrafos; sin cambios en las frases.

parrafos: On Sunday, May 4, in Peru's Pataz province in the northern Department of La Libertad region, near one of Peru's largest gold mines, police has found bodies of thirteen security guards who were kidnapped on Saturday, April 26, allegedly by individuals involved in illegal mining.
The security guards had been employed by private security firm R&R staff, a security company that serves Libmar, an artisanal miner operating on contract with the mining company Poderosa.

On Friday, May 2, the gold mining company, named La Poderosa ("Powerful" in Spanish), stated that it was disappointed that the police were not doing enough to prevent illegal mining. On Saturday, as reported by the local news site Diario Correo, a video, allegedly filmed by the criminals, started circulating on social media, showing the victims being murdered by gunshot at point-blank range. Video of the victims tied up and naked was also reportedly sent to their relatives as a form of ransom prior to their deaths, which was said to have persisted for a week.

Authorities believed that the perpetrators were connected with illegal mining. The victims, who were found "tied up in a pit," were initially dispatched to confront a gang that had ambushed the mine and taken control of it. The attempt to regain control of the mine was unsuccessful, and they were ultimately waylayed and captured, according to BBC.

After the discovery of the victims, the government in Peru levied a curfew on the Pataz province for the late-night hours, and gold mining in the area was suspended for 30 days. President Boluarte stated that there would be an armed military presence throughout the La Poderosa mining area, which he described as taking "full control."

A spokesperson for the company said on May 2: "The spiral of uncontrolled violence in Pataz is occurring despite the declaration of a state of emergency and the presence of a large police contingent which, unfortunately, has not been able to halt the deterioration of security conditions in the area."
The firm stated that the victims had been kidnapped on April 26, and are among several dozen of its employees who had been killed in gang-related violence within the mining area.

Violence related to unlawful mining has been on the rise in the region that the Ponderosa mine is located in, and Luis Guillermo Bringas, a prosecutor in Pataz, called the conflict "a war for mining pits" between mining firms and criminal gangs.

Peru is one of the world's largest gold producers, mining more than 100 tonnes a year - or about 4% of the entire world's annual supply. Reporterd suggested that similar incidents in Peru could potentially deter investors from doing business in the country.
titulo_es: La policía peruana encuentra los cuerpos de unos vigilantes de seguridad presuntamente secuestrados por mineros ilegales
resumen_es: En la provincia de Pataz (Perú) aparecen asesinados trece vigilantes de una mina de oro secuestrados días antes, presuntamente por mineros ilegales; el Gobierno decreta un toque de queda y suspende la minería en la zona.
nivel_motivo: El vocabulario es variado (waylayed, levied, point-blank range) pero la noticia es lineal y fácil de seguir: C1 se ajusta mejor que C2.

ideas_clave.idea: Police in Peru's Pataz province found the bodies of thirteen security guards working for a contractor of the Poderosa gold mine, who had been abducted a week earlier, allegedly by illegal miners.

Before the discovery, the mining company had criticised the police for not doing enough, and a video apparently made by the killers showing the executions circulated on social media after relatives had received ransom images.
The guards had been sent to retake the mine from a gang that had seized it, but they were ambushed and captured.
The government reacted by imposing a night-time curfew, suspending gold mining in the area for a month and deploying the army.
The company complained that violence kept spiralling despite a state of emergency and a large police presence, and said dozens of its workers had already been killed.
Local prosecutors describe the situation as a war between mining firms and criminal gangs for control of the mines.
As a major gold producer, Peru could see such violence discourage foreign investment.

resumen_modelo: The article reports that the Peruvian police found the bodies of thirteen security guards in Pataz province, near one of the country's largest gold mines, a week after they had been kidnapped, allegedly by people involved in illegal mining. The victims, employed by a firm working for a contractor of the Poderosa mining company, had been sent to recover a mine seized by a gang, but were ambushed and captured. Their relatives had received ransom images, and a video apparently showing their execution later circulated online. In response, the government imposed a night curfew, suspended mining in the area for thirty days and deployed the army. Nevertheless, the company stressed that violence had continued to escalate despite a state of emergency, and that dozens of its employees had already lost their lives. A local prosecutor even described the conflict as a war for control of the mines. Finally, the article points out that, since Peru is one of the world's leading gold producers, such incidents could deter investors.

preguntas.enunciado: Busca en el párrafo 2 una expresión que signifique «a quemarropa».
preguntas.pregunta: Find an expression meaning 'from very close range'.
preguntas.cita: showing the victims being murdered by gunshot at point-blank range
preguntas.explicacion: «At point-blank range» significa disparar a quemarropa, desde muy cerca.

preguntas.pregunta: What mission had the guards originally been given?
opciones: To escort a shipment of gold
To confront a gang that had taken control of the mine
To arrest illegal miners on behalf of the police
respuestas: To confront a gang that had taken control of the mine
preguntas.cita: were initially dispatched to confront a gang that had ambushed the mine and taken control of it
preguntas.explicacion: Los enviaron a enfrentarse a una banda que se había hecho con la mina. No se mencionan escoltas de oro, detenciones ni negociaciones.

preguntas.enunciado: Busca en el párrafo 3 una palabra que signifique «interceptados en una emboscada».
preguntas.pregunta: Find a word meaning 'ambushed, stopped by surprise'.
preguntas.cita: they were ultimately waylayed and captured
preguntas.explicacion: «To waylay» (en el texto con la grafía «waylayed», más habitual «waylaid») es interceptar o asaltar por sorpresa.

preguntas.pregunta: Which of these measures did the government NOT take after the discovery?

An armed military presence in the mining area
The nationalisation of the Poderosa mine

preguntas.explicacion: Se decretaron toque de queda, suspensión de la minería y presencia militar. La nacionalización no se menciona; «take full control» se refiere al control militar de la zona.

preguntas.pregunta: Why can the situation in Pataz be described as a 'war for mining pits'?
respuestas: Because criminal gangs linked to illegal mining are fighting legal mining companies for control of the gold mines, seizing them by force and killing dozens of workers, while the police and a state of emergency have failed to stop the violence.
preguntas.cita: called the conflict "a war for mining pits" between mining firms and criminal gangs
preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta debe combinar la lucha por el control de las minas, la violencia armada y la impotencia del Estado (párrafos 3, 5 y 6).

preguntas.pregunta: What economic consequences could this violence have for Peru?
respuestas: Since Peru is one of the largest gold producers in the world, insecurity and the suspension of mining could reduce output and exports and discourage foreign investors from doing business in the country.
preguntas.cita: Peru is one of the world's largest gold producers
preguntas.explicacion: El texto menciona la disuasión de inversores; la caída de producción se infiere de la suspensión de 30 días.
